summary: Twilio OTP auth integration fully validated. All 12 backend pytest cases pass (demo phones 8888888888/9999999999/7777777777 accept 1234 and return correct roles; wrong OTP -> 400; short phone -> 400; non-demo 1111111111 -> friendly 400 (Twilio 60200) with no user record created; verify-otp with no pending session -> 400 not 500; 5/10min rate limit triggers 429 on 6th send; token from demo login works on /auth/me, /cart/count, /products?limit=5). Frontend mobile app: login screen no longer contains 'Demo' or '1234' hints and shows 'You will receive a one-time password by SMS'; OTP screen shows 'OTP sent via SMS to your mobile number'; entering 1234 lands on Home with banner carousel and welcome text. /panel admin login with 9999999999 + 1234 succeeds and lands on Admin Dashboard. No Twilio-billable calls were made (only invalid 1111111111 and demo allowlist phones were used, per constraint). Deprecated packages detected: none. React Native warnings observed: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow) and props.pointerEvents deprecated (use style.pointerEvents) - RN-web console warnings, low priority.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native web console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Appears on login and panel screens. Reference: search styles across /app/frontend/app/*.tsx and /app/frontend/src/theme for shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset usage and migrate to boxShadow for web parity.
React Native web console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Reference: search for pointerEvents=... prop usage in /app/frontend/app/*.tsx.

action_items: Optional cleanup: migrate any legacy 'shadow*' style props to the RN-web-compatible 'boxShadow' equivalent to silence deprecation warnings.
Optional cleanup: migrate 'pointerEvents' prop to 'style.pointerEvents' where used.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:75 _e164 falls back to '+<digits>' for any length not 10 or 12; harmless because Twilio still rejects with 60200, but consider raising 400 early for lengths >10 that don't start with 91.

In-memory _otp_store / _otp_rate is process-local; if backend runs under multiple workers, demo-phone OTP verification could fail intermittently. Not observed here (single worker) but worth noting for future scaling.
seed_data_creation: None. Tests only use pre-seeded demo phones on the allowlist.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Twilio OTP integration is stable. Demo allowlist phones (9999999999, 8888888888, 7777777777, 6666666666) always take OTP 1234 with no SMS billing. Only 1111111111 is safe to exercise the real Twilio path (returns friendly 400). NEVER send-otp for any other 10-digit number. The backend uses in-memory rate limiting (5 sends per 10 min per phone); back-to-back test runs may 429 - tests skip gracefully in that case.
